scripts.dev: concurrently --names 'TIDE,SEA,WEATHER,WEB' --prefix-colors 'green,blue,yellow,cyan' 'npm run tide:dev' 'npm run sea-dev:dev' 'npm run weather:dev' 'npm run web:dev'
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @seas/database && dotenv -e .env -- npm run db:push -w @seas/database
scripts.db:push: npm run build -w @seas/database && dotenv -e .env -- npm run db:push -w @seas/database
scripts.build: npm run build -w @seas/database && npm run build -w @seas/tide-scraper && npm run build -w @seas/sea-temp-scraper && npm run build -w @seas/weather-service && npm run build -w @seas/web
